references.text: The same type of grain offerings (silver plate, silver bowl, and fine flour mixed with oil) was given by Netanel, son of Zuar, from the tribe of Issachar.
Summary of all the gifts from the tribal leaders, including the silver plates and silver bowls mentioned in verse 13.
Description of the plates and bowls to be made for the tabernacle, the same type of vessels mentioned in Numbers 7:13.
Explanation of the sanctuary shekel as a weight standard, the same standard used in Numbers 7:13.
Regulations for the grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, the same type of offering described in Numbers 7:13.
The grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil used in daily offerings, corresponding to the offering in Numbers 7:13.
